verdict.rationale: Earth Class Mail's own marketing says it offers APIs to connect the mailbox to other tools, which suggests programmatic, non-UI access suitable for automation. That is only a single thin marketing mention, with no detail on headless or CI operation. Missing for 10: public API reference documentation, programmatic authentication (API keys or tokens) for unattended use, a CLI or SDK, documented CI or headless workflow examples, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Use APIs to connect your virtual mailbox to the tools you already use, so your documents and mail stay in sync and your work keeps moving.
API integrations to connect your mailbox with the tools you already use
